messages:
Priya R: opened a small PR to document an edge-case: tenants using very short cooldowns saw oscillation during synthetic loadtests. Link: https://go/repo/pr/4621 :mag:
Ben L: Good find. Can we show a before/after YAML snippet that demonstrates the fix? People like concrete diffs.
Priya R: Yup, added a short delta showing cooldown 60 -> 300 and targetUtilization tweak. Kept it tiny.
Omar: Add a one-line explanation of why short cooldowns cause oscillation (autoscaler flips between scale up/down due to noisy metrics).
Priya R: Added that plus an inline graph screenshot placeholder.
Nora: Also mention the SLA implication: transient p99 spikes during oscillation, advise test with 5-10 minute windows.
Ben L: Tiny nit: change wording from "avoid oscillation" to "reduce oscillation likelihood".
Priya R: Done. Also included a short Node SDK snippet showing how to read current policy and patch it atomically.
Omar: Please include error-handling for 409/412 in the snippet. People hit that.
Priya R: Added try/catch and a note on retries.
Docs Bot: Preview built: https://go/docs-preview/4621. CI green.
Ben L: LGTM, approved. Merge when ready.
Priya R: Merging now, will follow up with a small follow-up PR to add a perf test case to the repo. Thanks!
